saw_lines: Streetwear buyers want a reason to buy this pair today, and they check authenticity before they trust a store.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where a new buyer looks for an offer.
Your site offers up to 50% off, yet only 1 of 16 ads mention percent off. Lead three new ads with that offer in the first line and on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 31 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers up to 50% off, yet only 1 of 16 copy ads mention a discount, so most buyers never see it. Lead three new ads with that offer in the first line and print it on the creative.

None of your 16 copy ads carries a proof number, so a new buyer has no reason to trust the store. Collect one number, such as your review count or orders shipped, and open two new ads with it on the creative.
4 of 16 copy ads open on the same Google Fitbit Air Classic line, so other stories get no real test. Keep that opener in one ad and test two new angles against it, such as price and a new drop.
8 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage instead of the product on screen, so each buyer has to search again. Point each one to the product page for the item the ad shows.

ads_1: Creative led by the 50% off offer, tested against the Fitbit opener
